description: The Creeping Quill resembles a massive, ink-stained feather that moves as though alive. It glides silently across the ground, leaving a trail of black ink that evaporates moments later. Its origins are unknown, but it's said to appear in libraries and ancient archives, hunting for forgotten knowledge to absorb.
languages: Understands Common, Deep Speech but cannot speak

traits.name: Inky Escape
traits.description: When the Creeping Quill takes damage, it can use its reaction to release a cloud of dark ink, becoming invisible until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Hover
traits.description: The Creeping Quill can hover without needing to touch the ground.

actions.name: Ink Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Absorb Knowledge
actions.description: The Creeping Quill touches a book or scroll, absorbing its knowledge. It can learn any languages or magical incantations stored within. This process destroys the written material.
